meta.title: Replace LINQ Any+Single patterns with Where+FirstOrDefault for better performance
meta.body_summary: Replace LINQ Any+Single patterns with Where+FirstOrDefault across 14 instances in test platform managers to avoid double enumeration and improve debug information.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot replaced LINQ Any+Single with Where+FirstOrDefault across 14 sites; Evangelink's review led to multiple iterations adding duplicate detection, localization, and a validation helper before merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 790 changed lines across 18 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor by absolute volume. As a targeted LINQ performance cleanup, it merged after multiple review rounds without benchmark evidence, fitting the pattern of a low-risk, correctness-focused perf PR.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer Evangelink requested: uppercase tuple naming, throw localized error for multiple duplicates, capture all extensions with same UID, introduce a validation helper to factorize common checks, improve XML documentation, and convert to extension methods.
review_details.performance_claim: Replacing Any+Single with Where+FirstOrDefault reduces double enumeration and provides better debug information.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: LINQ optimization in C# test platform with correctness edge cases; merge required iterative improvements driven by detailed code review but no demand for performance evidence.

detection_detail.code_reading: Evangelink read through every LINQ change, requested improvements via inline comments on tuple naming, duplicate handling, factorization, and documentation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks or profiling; only narrative performance rationale in PR body.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All maintainer feedback (duplicate detection, validation helper, naming, localization) was addressed in subsequent commits within the same PR.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced Any+Single patterns with Where+FirstOrDefault across 14 instances in TestHostManager, TestHostControllersManager, TestHostOrchestratorManager. Later introduced ExtensionValidationHelper to factor out duplicate UID validation and updated localization resources.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Many .xlf localization files were updated with new error message entries.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: replace Any+Single with Where+FirstOrDefault in three managers.
Fix tuple naming and implement proper multiple duplicates detection (commit 4dadb87).
Complete XLF localization for new error message.
Update error message to capture all extensions with same UID and list their types.
Create ExtensionValidationHelper to factorize duplicate validation checks.
Refactor ExtensionValidationHelper based on review (extension methods, explicit types, XML docs).
Final fix commits by Evangelink to correct issues in helper.

review_signals.summary: Requested throwing a useful localized message when multiple results exist, and use uppercase tuple elements.
review_signals.action_taken: Fixed in commit 4dadb87: tuple naming and multiple duplicates detection.

review_signals.summary: Asked to update error message to accept a list of types with duplicated UID and capture all extensions.
review_signals.action_taken: Implemented in commit d0831143, updating error message and listing all duplicate types.

review_signals.summary: Requested introducing a validation helper to factorize common duplicate checks.
review_signals.action_taken: Created ExtensionValidationHelper in commit e1fc921, refactored in subsequent commits.

review_signals.summary: Requested missing XML documentation, explicit types, expression body, and newline at end of file.
review_signals.action_taken: Implemented in commit 910b381 and later by Evangelink in commit b8f800e.

review_signals.summary: Confirmed implementation of validation helper in commit 1a2b3c4.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with initial LINQ pattern replacement across three files.
Evangelink reviewed within ~1.8h and left detailed inline comments on every instance.
Copilot responded with a series of commits addressing naming, duplicate detection, localization, and factorization.
Further review rounds refined ExtensionValidationHelper (extension methods, XML docs, explicit types).
Maintainer Evangelink made final fix commit and merged PR after ~23h of active collaboration.
